title: Taiwanese American Student Association at UC Berkeley
content_html:
The Taiwanese American Student Association (TASA) at the University of California, Berkeley is a social and cultural student organization founded in 2003. It was established to provide a way for Taiwanese American students at Berkeley to connect with and understand their Taiwanese heritage and identity, and it welcomes students from all backgrounds who share an interest in Taiwanese and Taiwanese American culture.

TASA’s programming centers on biweekly general events and a distinctive “family system” — smaller themed groups within the organization that hold their own regular gatherings. Recurring events have included Taiwanese food-making nights, mahjong, a Mid-Autumn Festival celebration, and Taiwanese night market-themed socials. The organization also holds collaborative events with other groups, including the Taiwanese Student Association (TSA) at Berkeley, TAO at UC Davis, and the Global Leadership Organization.

TASA’s stated mission emphasizes promoting the presence of the Taiwanese American community in both local and national arenas — extending its purpose beyond campus social life to broader civic visibility. The organization maintains an active web presence at tasa.berkeley.edu, a CalLink directory listing, an Instagram account (@tasa.berkeley) with over 1,500 followers, and a Facebook page.
